integrity: Original evaluated second-moment formula and sharp inequality rest on an explicit proof; numerical reproducibility checks are corroborative and are not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Two congruent rectangular boxes in R^3 with positive side lengths and a Haar-uniform relative rotation; no full distribution, general polyhedra, nonuniform rotations or higher moments; priority subject to further historical checks.
title: Exact orientational excluded-volume variance of three-dimensional rectangular boxes
